name: Anglers Haul
summary: Your fishing rod reels in enchanted books, name tags and saddles more often and soggy boots and sticks less often.
logoPrompt: A wooden fishing rod pulling a glowing treasure chest out of blue water, an enchanted book and a name tag sparkling above it, a small fish jumping beside it, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Less junk on the line, more treasure.

description: **Anglers Haul makes fishing more rewarding: the rod brings up treasure more often and junk less often.**
- Treasure such as enchanted books, bows, name tags, saddles and nautilus shells: 8% of all catches instead of 5%.
- Junk such as old boots, sticks and bowls: 7% instead of 10%.
- Fish stay at 85%, so food from fishing does not change.
- Luck of the Sea still helps on top: at level III about 14% treasure and only 1% junk.
Import the .mcpack, then turn it on under Behavior Packs when you create or edit a world. Then go fishing as usual.
- Made for Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 and newer. It can be added to or removed from an existing world at any time.
- The items themselves are unchanged; jungles keep their own fish and junk.
- Like every behavior pack, it turns off achievements in the world it is added to.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
